title: Disposition, then the Lord’s Prayer petitions (chs. 19–30)
english: First be disposed for prayer; then say [[Our Father in the heavens >> Bible:Matthew 6:9]]. Ask that his name be hallowed, his kingdom come, his will be done; ask [[today’s bread >> Bible:Matthew 6:11]], forgiveness of debts, and to be kept from temptation and delivered from evil — each petition read for the soul as well as the body.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 3 De oratione (OCR); no O’Meara/Greer/Chadwick wording.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Posture, kinds of prayer, closing word (chs. 31–34) — On Prayer CLOSEOUT
english: Last come posture, place, and times of prayer — including facing east — and the [[four kinds of prayer >> Bible:1 Timothy 2:1]] named in Scripture. This closes the word to Ambrose and Tatiana. Glory to Christ. Amen.
